summary: On Arch Linux install ansible or ansible-core with pacman; other Ansible packages are in the Arch repos, and issues go to the package's GitLab repository.
questions: How do I install Ansible on Arch Linux?

answer_card.title: Install Ansible on Arch Linux
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
sudo pacman -S ansible        # full
sudo pacman -S ansible-core   # minimal
```
Report issues in the package's GitLab repository.
